note: The shape of substrate/pvp-callouts.json (gitignored: this machine's lines). tools/m59-pvp-callout.mjs says one out loud when a hostile player enters a loud character's map (policy pvp_loud, or a combat order). {enemy} is the player's name, {me} the speaker's. These generic lines are used when no local file exists. A line may instead be { "text", "voice" }: voice is a character name or a list of names, and that line is only picked for a speaker it names.
